scripts.title: Dibape Exe
scripts.features:
The script completely bypasses hardcoded entity names. Instead, it dynamically loops through every model inside Workspace.ScriptedMap.Entities. Rather than pulling a static TextColor3 value (which often defaults to white), it extracts the live color sequence directly from the custom gradient element. It grabs the exact color value of the first keypoint and applies it instantly to a globally visible Highlight effect. This ensures every Baddie glows with its actual, real-time rarity color (even Secret variants realtime changing colors for rainbow,nuclear etc.).
Full Path i got from dex:

Game.Workspace.ScriptedMap.Entities.[AnyBaddieName].Torso.QuestionMarkBillboard.TextLabel.RarityGradient

For Developers (Upgrading/Forking):
If you want to fork, optimize, or build upon this project, the core color data is stored inside the RarityGradient object as a ColorSequence. You can modify the script to transition between multiple keypoints if you want an animated rainbow ESP, or use this path to anchor your own custom UI tracking systems. Feel free to upgrade it
